repos.name: uber/ADR
repos.description: ADR secures enterprise AI agents through observability, security benchmarking, and threat detection. Deployed at Uber.
repos.one_liner: An enterprise-grade security and observability framework designed to protect and benchmark AI agents.
bullets: Built in Python, focusing on security benchmarking and threat detection for LLM-based workflows.
Provides observability layers to monitor agent behavior and prevent unauthorized actions.
Designed for enterprise environments to ensure compliance and safety in agentic deployments.
Used internally at Uber to secure large-scale AI agent infrastructure.

repos.name: nealbridges/VulnHunter
repos.description: Agentic AI security scanner that hunts exploitable vulnerabilities like an adversary, proves them with executable PoCs, and fixes them test-first. A maintained fork of Capital One's VulnHunter, rebuilt for any agent harness.
repos.one_liner: An agentic AI security scanner that automates vulnerability hunting, PoC generation, and remediation.
bullets: Leverages agentic AI workflows to identify exploitable vulnerabilities in software.
Automatically generates executable Proofs of Concept (PoCs) to validate findings.
Implements a test-first approach to suggest and verify security patches.
Maintained fork of Capital One's original tool, optimized for modern security engineering pipelines.

repos.name: earthtojake/text-to-cad
repos.one_liner: A specialized tool that integrates CAD capabilities into AI agents for automated design and engineering.
bullets: Python-based library designed to bridge the gap between LLM reasoning and CAD software.
Enables agents to programmatically generate, modify, and export 3D geometry.
Useful for automating mechanical design workflows and rapid prototyping via natural language.
Provides a structured interface for agents to interact with complex engineering file formats.

repos.name: LaurieWired/GhidraMCP
repos.one_liner: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI agents to interact directly with the Ghidra reverse engineering suite.
bullets: Java-based implementation connecting the Model Context Protocol to Ghidra's API.
Allows LLMs to query binary analysis data, function signatures, and decompiled code.
Facilitates agentic workflows in cybersecurity, such as automated vulnerability research and malware analysis.
Standardizes how AI agents interface with complex desktop-based security tooling.

repos.name: amontlabs/lcu
repos.description: Codex computer use, decoupled from the app, for usage inside any harness.
repos.one_liner: A decoupled computer-use framework that allows AI agents to control desktop applications across various harnesses.
bullets: Python-based architecture designed to separate agent logic from specific application environments.
Enables cross-platform automation by providing a standardized interface for 'computer use' tasks.
Highly modular, allowing developers to plug the agent into custom harnesses or existing desktop workflows.
Focuses on the infrastructure layer of agentic interaction with GUI-based software.
